term: buscar lo que no se ha perdido

1.consolidated_definition: Inmiscuirse alguien en asuntos que no le corresponden y exponerse a sufrir contrariedades por esa causa.
1.en_consolidated_definition: To meddle in affairs that do not concern oneself and to expose oneself to difficulties as a result of this.
